verdict.rationale: Bento documents a first-party Google ADK integration that captures every model call, tool call, and agent step with one line. It also says integrations exist for some SDKs (with `bento.track_ai` as the fallback for others), captures LLM calls at the SDK level, and ingests spans from any framework over OpenTelemetry. None of the named frameworks (LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, the Vercel AI SDK) is explicitly documented as having a ready-made integration. Missing for 10: explicit LangChain, OpenAI SDK, and Vercel AI SDK integrations, a documented integration catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
